name: v4.20.1
body:
> [!NOTE]
> This release is the immediate mitigation of the CI / release failure in `v4.20.0`, to distribute the latest version to all registries.

## What's Changed
* ci: fix GoReleaser build matrix by @Fontinalis in https://github.com/golang-migrate/migrate/pull/1434


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/golang-migrate/migrate/compare/v4.20.0...v4.20.1
